note: Printed claims only (Step 6). ER-32 (ERRATA sheet p.3, Book V page 12) applied: five removals, five additions, 55 wires; pairs recorded row by row as printed on the sheet (remove column -> add column). MANUAL DEFECT (stop rule; open-questions.md O-C8): with ER-32 as printed, 5L loses its only wire (5L/6G), so relay 5 set 2 has one wired terminal (5N) and carries nothing, and the added 4X/6L and 5N/6K form a dead stub. No nickel or penny input can then reach relay 3, so the printed "two nickels", "one nickel and five pennies" and "ten pennies" payments never light output light 1; those steps are dropped from this printed fixture. The uncorrected printed list, and ER-32 without its 5L/6G removal, both pay on two nickels and on ten pennies. Neither pays on one nickel and five pennies in this simulator: with relays 5 and 6 set and the dial resting on D5, the carry to 4E lasts only while the wiper is still on the D5 pad after pb6 makes (19 ms here; relay 6 then drops), which rests on fallbacks O-R1, O-R3, O-R5, so a ruling on ER-32 alone does not restore that step. Script: one dime from power on (the printed procedure), Drive Away; an unpaid Drive Away (alarm, still on after pb3 is released) cleared by a dime, Drive Away; five pennies (not enough money) then Drive Away (alarm) cleared by a dime, Drive Away. Lamp states after the Drive Away re-set, between coins, after a partial deposit, and after an over-deposit are not printed and are not asserted. Output light 1 also lights through coil 2 (2E=1A) while the alarm latch holds, so out1=on is the payment observable only from the re-set state. Relay 1 is wired as a self-interrupting buzzer (coil end 1F fed through its own NC contact 1H/1J), so "Relay 1 ON" is an until on relay1=no, not a steady expect. pb6 is held until the dial has run down to the D0/D19 stop because pb6 (6X/D18) is the motor's only feed; the hold length is a script choice. The relay 5/6 penny count is not cleared by the re-set and is left set at the end. Rotary run rate, coast and geometry are profile fallbacks O-R1, O-R3, O-R5; dwell windows are sized for a run rate as slow as 25 rpm.
